title: Story premise ENT106: The Memory Cloud Weather Report
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (fantasy and science fiction). Hook: The forecast says scattered memories. Takeaway/theme: A specific cue can organize a fictional collection better than a vague category.
description: A cloud archivist wants to retrieve one happy picnic memory from a fantasy sky cabinet, but all the cloud drawers look identical. They sort the clouds by the objects visible inside instead of by cloud shape, find the red picnic kite, and label the drawer with that distinctive detail.
